visual.issue: Photos 3, 5, 7, 8 and 9 show two whole pages shrunk side by side instead of readable crops; the year page in photo 5 has tiny digits, and every tablet is cut off at the bottom edge (footer and DEC tab clipped). Breaks r013.
Hero bullet 'Linked from the year to the hour' overclaims: time blocks are not links, the day page is the deepest level.
The early-buyer Head start button on the Year page wraps badly ('STARTING IN 2026? HEAD / START') next to a wrapped 'TAP ANY / DATE'; the button that autumn buyers are told to tap looks broken.

On head-start pages the NOV and DEC tabs are highlighted and go to Nov/Dec 2026, while the same tabs on every other page go to Nov/Dec 2027; identical labels with different targets, and no tab route to Nov/Dec 2027 from head-start pages.
Back tablet in the hero is mostly hidden behind the cover tablet; its 'January 11' title is cut off, so it reads as a cluttered half-page.
Eyebrow and title repeat the same words ('SETUP CHECK' over 'Setup check').
'The top bar, on every page' table lists Year, Projects, Notes but omits Home, leaving an empty cell; Setup check's version includes Home.
Start here cards 2, 3 and 4 have large empty lower halves (r006).
Two boxes on every week page are both labelled 'Notes' (dot grid and lined), which reads as a duplicate.
Week chips wrap so 'Week 5' sits alone on a second line under the others.
Row spacing differs between neighbouring month blocks (February/June/July rows sit lower than January/March), so dates do not line up across a row.
Head start week 9 forward arrow goes to the January month page instead of Week 1, and Week 1 has no back arrow to the head start.
Setup check promises 'jump and come back' but has no back button on the destination pages; return relies on Home then Setup check (printed on the page).
